about_the_game:
Super Farmer

Embark on a 100-level adventure and become a legend of the orchard!

In this challenging farm world, 100 meticulously designed levels await you! Each level brings unique challenges, ensuring your harvesting journey never gets boring!

Game Features

🌟 Epic Level Journey

  • Spanning 100 exciting levels

  • Progressive difficulty design, from easy to challenging

  • Unique score targets for each level

  • Unlock higher difficulty challenges after completion

🎮 Intense Competitive Gameplay

  • Engage in tactical battles with pests

  • Meet other farmers? Time for Rock, Paper, Scissors!

  • Strategic energy management

  • Compete for the best harvesting positions

💎 Powerful Item System

  • Freeze Aura: Make fruits respond to you alone

  • Slow Trap: Hinder your opponents' movement

  • Fruit Magnet: Become the king of harvesting

  • Fog Bomb: Tactically confuse your enemies

🛍️ Flexible Shop System

  • Exchange points for powerful items

  • Strategically combine different items

  • Plan your point usage wisely

Game Highlights

  • Perfect blend of casual and strategy

  • Rich content ensures long-term playability

  • Easy to learn, deep to master

Challenge Yourself

  • 100 levels with progressive difficulty

  • Unique completion requirements for each level

  • Dual scoring from fruit collection and pest elimination

  • Unlock levels and showcase your farming skills

Are you ready to start your 100-level adventure?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: 1 gigahertz (GHz) or faster processor or SoC
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9 or later with WDDM 1.0 driver
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: "Super Farmer" is a fast-paced game where you compete against pests and farmers in a vibrant orchard. Run, harvest fruits, and use items to outmaneuver rivals. Race through 100 levels, manage energy, and battle farmers to become the ultimate champion!
supported_languages:
English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Japanese*, Korean*, Polish*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
